component.title: UndoBanner
component.purpose: Make destructive work reversible without forcing a confirmation interruption.

states.description: A visible, time-bounded undo action with progress.
Rollback is in flight and the action cannot be double-submitted.
Rollback succeeded and the user receives clear closure.
Rollback failed with a reason and an explicit retry path.

claims.statement: Undo is available before expiry, while rollback progress, completion, and failure remain explicit.
The action becomes a full-width mobile control without clipping the explanation.
Border and action affordances retain non-color meaning in forced-colors mode.
